sentences.text: Mr. Shraman Sarkar, Mr. Soumyadeep Das ...for the petitioner
Present petition has filed for transfer of Matrimonial Suit No.371 of 2023 having been filed by the opposite party/husband.
The suit is pending before the court of learned Additional District and Sessions Judge at Baruipur.

entities.text: Additional District and Sessions Judge at Baruipur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner had already filed a criminal case under Sections 498A/494/34 of IPC at Narendrapur Police Station.

Learned counsel submits that presently petitioner is residing at Purba Tetulberia, Vivekananda Sarani, Post Ofifce - Panchpota,
Police Station - Narendrapur, Kolkata.
Learned counsel submits that the petitioner facing severe hardship by filing of the present matrimonial suit and, therefore, the present petition may be transferred.
Issue notice to the opposite party and the learned advocate representing the opposite party through permissible mode.
Let the matter appear on 18th June, 2025.
All parties shall act on the server copy of this order duly downloaded from the official website of this Court.
